overview: Give us a list of what you want changed on your Framer site. We work in a duplicate of your project first so your live site stays safe, then make the edits: spacing and type fixes, new sections, extra pages, mobile layout problems or updated visuals. We check every change at phone, tablet and desktop widths and publish once you approve. You also get a short note listing everything we touched.

faq: Will my live site change before I approve?
No. We work in a duplicate of your project, show you the result, and publish to the live site only when you say yes.
Can you work on a site someone else built?
Yes. We look at how it is structured first, and if it is messy we tell you honestly what is quick to fix and what would be better handled as a redesign.
You invite us as a collaborator on your Framer project. We never ask for your login, and you can remove us from the project whenever the work ends.
Can you add code or animations?
Yes. We add effects with Framer's built-in tools first, and use a small code component only when needed. We keep pages light so the site stays fast.
